metadata.description:
Skyzone started in 2020 with an entirely different sounding record, I felt like the sound was too experimental when the homie Eric (from 4km) started it but then I revisited the record in 2022 and knew exactly who to reach out to: Jamee Cornelia and Jadyn Violet. Jamee came in with an absolutely infectious energy and such a superstar verse, then Jadyn laced the record with some beautiful melodies and I went back in and redid my verse and we had a whole ass bop 



Written by Jon Waltz, Jamee Cornelia & Jadyn Violet 

Prod by 4km

Artwork by Jules Lauber

metadata.description:
Chapter 1 of my journey into web 3 began with three small batch editions of Music NFTs. If you're a holder of this NFT it most likely means you joined me during that time, so welcome aboard. This is a collectors item and represents a moment in my personal web 3 history. 

The medley you hear starts with 'Meet Me On The Lake' - my first ever Music NFT, 10 editions and a national radio debut on BBC Radio Scotland. Next comes 'Low Light' a small, peaceful song from 2020 which found its way into many hearts on Twitter space performances and was subsequently dropped as 20 editions. Finally, this trilogy of tracks is completed by 'In The Smoke', my genesis drop on SoundXYZ.
metadata.name: Early For Emma

metadata.description: Another Life is a music NFT/PFP collection by Violetta Zironi: 5 original songs recorded on tape paired with 5200 unique hand drawn PFPs inspired by the music.  The songs are written and produced by Violetta Zironi and Michael Hunter Ochs.  The artworks are hand drawn by Arianna Rea.
metadata.name: Another Life by Violetta Zironi #5200

metadata.description: Welcome to "Music & Me," the podcast that delves deep into the captivating world of music on the blockchain. On our 2nd ep, "Track 2," we're honored to feature Violetta Zironi, a multi-talented singer, songwriter, and musician. Join us as we uncover the creative process behind Violetta's beloved records, exploring the inspirations and stories that have shaped her music. From melodic melodies to inspiring lyrics, this episode offers an intimate and insightful conversation with Violetta. Additionally, Violetta generously shares advice for aspiring musicians interested in entering the world of WEB3, providing valuable insights and guidance. Don't miss this remarkable episode of "Music & Me" as we celebrate the power of music and the profound impact it has on our lives.
metadata.name: Music & Me: Track 2 ft Violetta Zironi
